description: The chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts across different genres in two distinct datasets, Open-Ended and Constrained sets. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Sample Count" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick labels at intervals of 20. For each category, there are two bars: a blue bar representing the Open-Ended set and a pink bar representing the Constrained set. The bars are grouped together by category, with the blue bar preceding the pink bar. The values for the Open-Ended set are approximately 79, 80, 68, and 62 for Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, respectively. The corresponding values for the Constrained set are approximately 122, 87, 100, and 130. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar.
